claim: When a standard queue reaches its quota of in-flight messages (received by a consumer but not yet deleted), short polling returns the OverLimit error message, and long polling returns no error messages.

evidence.quote: For most standard queues (depending on queue traffic and message backlog), there can be a maximum of approximately 120,000 in flight messages (received from a queue by a consumer, but not yet deleted from the queue). If you reach this quota while using short polling, Amazon SQS returns the OverLimit error message. If you use long polling, Amazon SQS returns no error messages.
